metadata.description: Personal skills developed and curated by liuxj.

plugins.name: agent-skill-authoring
plugins.description: 撰写、优化与审查 Agent 技能 (Skill/Prompt Rule) 的高级实战指南。当用户要求创建新 Skill、修改现有 Skill，或需要将某种工作流/经验总结为 Agent 行为规范时使用。本规程确保生成的 Skill 具备防偷懒/防伪造、动机驱动 (Theory of Mind)、弹性分级与闭环修复能力，拒绝形式主义模板。 Make sure to use this skill whenever designing, drafting, editing, or auditing agent skills, custom prompts, or behavioral rules.

plugins.name: chatgpt-image-generator
plugins.description: Automates the end-to-end workflow of generating images, logos, UI assets, and illustrations using ChatGPT (DALL-E) via the browser subagent. Use this skill whenever the user asks to use ChatGPT to design, generate, or download images, icons, or visual concepts.

plugins.name: content-infographic
plugins.description: Turn conversation content, notes, or an explanation into a single shareable infographic-style image (PNG) — a distilled visual summary with intentional typography and layout, not just a screenshot of text. Use this whenever the user asks to turn something into an image, picture, poster, card, or infographic ("整理成图片", "做成一张图", "生成一张总结图", "做成长图/知识卡片", "turn this into an image", "make an infographic", "summarize this as a visual", "make a poster/card of this"), even if they don't use the word "infographic" explicitly. Also use when the user wants a shareable visual recap of something already discussed in the conversation.

plugins.name: doc-to-docx
plugins.description: 将 .doc 与 .wps 格式文档转换为 .docx 格式文档的转换工具。优先调用 WPS/Word COM 接口，跨平台或无 Office 环境下自动降级调用 LibreOffice。当用户需要将 .doc/.wps 转化为 .docx、批量转换旧版 Word/WPS 文档格式时使用此技能。

plugins.name: drawio-skill
plugins.description: Use when the user requests diagrams, flowcharts, architecture diagrams, ER diagrams, UML / sequence / class diagrams, SysML / MBSE diagrams (block definition, internal block, requirement, parametric), BPMN business process diagrams, swimlane / cross-functional flowcharts, network topology, cloud architecture from Terraform or Kubernetes manifests, ML/DL model figures (Transformer/CNN/LSTM), mind maps, or any visualization. Also use proactively when explaining systems with 3+ components, complex data flows, or relationships that benefit from visual representation. Best suited when the diagram needs custom styling, rich shape vocabulary, swimlanes, or exportable images (PNG/SVG/PDF/JPG). Generates .drawio XML and exports locally via the native draw.io desktop CLI.

plugins.name: frontend-dev
plugins.description: Full-stack frontend development combining premium UI design, cinematic animations, AI-generated media assets, persuasive copywriting, and visual art. Builds complete, visually striking web pages with real media, advanced motion, and compelling copy. Use when building landing pages, marketing sites, product pages, dashboards, generating media assets (image/video/audio/music), writing conversion copy, creating generative art, or implementing cinematic scroll animations.

plugins.name: html-interactive-report
plugins.description: Generate a self-contained interactive HTML file as a modern replacement for traditional Word/Excel/PDF/TXT deliverables — data reports, financial/statistical tables, formal documents, slide-style presentations, or checklists/manuals. Use this skill whenever the user asks for a report, dashboard, spreadsheet-style output, formal document, or presentation and wants an HTML/interactive/web-page format instead of a static file, or explicitly says things like "做成网页" "做成HTML" "交互式报告" "可以点的报表" "turn this into an interactive HTML page/report/dashboard". Also trigger when the deliverable clearly benefits from sorting/filtering/navigation/collapsible sections even if the user didn't say "HTML" explicitly but asked for a report/table as a webpage.

plugins.name: image-understanding
plugins.description: Inspect, describe, OCR, and analyze image files or image URLs via a multimodal vision model. Use when Codex needs external vision for PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, or BMP images; when built-in image reading is unavailable or insufficient; or when the user asks to identify objects, landmarks, documents, screenshots, charts, text, or visual details.

plugins.name: imagegen
plugins.description: Generate or edit raster images when the task benefits from AI-created bitmap visuals such as photos, illustrations, textures, sprites, mockups, or transparent-background cutouts. Use when Codex should create a brand-new image, transform an existing image, or derive visual variants from references, and the output should be a bitmap asset rather than repo-native code or vector. Do not use when the task is better handled by editing existing SVG/vector/code-native assets, extending an established icon or logo system, or building the visual directly in HTML/CSS/canvas.

plugins.name: karpathy-guidelines
plugins.description: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes. Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring code to avoid overcomplication, make surgical changes, surface assumptions, and define verifiable success criteria.

plugins.name: manage-skill-repository
plugins.description: Create, import, update, validate, and publish Agent Skills in a shared GitHub repository compatible with npx skills add, Claude Code marketplaces, and Codex. Use when adding an owned skill, registering a collected third-party skill, editing catalog metadata, regenerating plugin manifests, checking repository structure, or preparing a skills release.

plugins.name: markitdown
plugins.description: Use when needing to convert files (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, images, audio, EPUB, ZIP, YouTube URLs) to Markdown for LLM consumption or text analysis. Use when user mentions "markitdown", "convert to markdown", "extract text from document", or needs to read binary/office file contents.

plugins.name: mermaid-diagram-generator
plugins.description: Automates the workflow of creating, rendering, and exporting high-resolution diagrams using Mermaid Live Editor (https://mermaid.live/edit) via the browser subagent. Use this skill whenever the user asks to draw diagrams (architecture, flowchart, sequence, ER, class, etc.) in Mermaid and download/export them as pristine PNG/SVG images.

plugins.name: serve-html
plugins.description: 通过 HTTP 在本地访问 HTML 页面。当需要预览 HTML 文件、测试静态站点、或避免 file:// 协议限制时使用。

plugins.name: visual-frontend-verification
plugins.description: 前端与视觉类改动(UI、Web 应用、CSS/HTML/React/Vue/SVG/Canvas 组件与图表)完成后的自我验证规程,核心是不许偷懒:必须用真实渲染截图确认效果,发现问题立即修复并重新验证直至通过,不允许仅凭代码改动或终端无报错就宣称完成。当编写、修改或调试前端 UI、样式、响应式布局、交互组件或图表时使用这个规程,即使用户没有明确要求"验证"或"截图"。
